## Walkthrough

Six test artifacts (one shell helper and five KIND cluster YAMLs) updated to kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4; component extraArgs and kubeletExtraArgs converted from map-style key/value to list-style `{name, value}` entries, preserving existing flag values.

## Changes

**Kubeadm Configuration API Upgrade**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Kubeadm config patch generator functions** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|`patch_kind_config_for_dra` and `patch_kind_config_for_was` now emit kubeadm API `kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4` and express `scheduler`, `controllerManager`, and `apiServer` `extraArgs` as arrays of `{name, value}` entries (including flags like `enable-aggregator-routing`, `runtime-config`, and `v`).|
|**KIND cluster kubeadm patch configurations** <br> `hack/testing/kind-cluster-tas.yaml`, `hack/testing/kind-cluster.yaml`, `hack/testing/multikueue/manager-cluster.kind.yaml`, `hack/testing/multikueue/worker-cluster.kind.yaml`|Control-plane and worker `kubeadmConfigPatches` updated to `kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4`; `extraArgs` and `kubeletExtraArgs` converted from map (`key: value`) to list (`- name: ..., value: ...`) format, preserving values such as `enable-aggregator-routing`, `v: "3"`, and `runtime-config`.|

### Review by [@mimowo](https://github.com/mimowo) (commented) — 2026-06-09T07:17:50Z

- **hack/testing/e2e-common.sh:1361** by [@mimowo](https://github.com/mimowo) — 2026-06-09T07:17:50Z
```diff
@@ -1343,6 +1353,51 @@ EOF
     fi
 }
 
+# Wait until Kueue mutating webhooks accept requests.
+# deployment/Available only means pods exist; the webhook listener and service
+# endpoints may still be starting (connection refused) or not yet propagated.
+# $1 kubeconfig
+# $2 timeout in seconds (default: 180)
+function wait_for_kueue_webhook_ready {
```

  I think this shouldn't be part of the PR as I cannot see any relationship.
  
  In fact, this should not be needed, because we wait in Kueue readiness probe for the webhook server to be ready, see here: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/main/cmd/kueue/main.go#L596-L613
  
  I think more likely what happened is that we have a flake in our helpers for rolling updates that we don't wait for proper unregistering of old Endpoints. 
  
  So I think likely the flake fix is this line alone: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11981/changes#diff-2e6108aa98030ed90991bf0aedca66477b40aa916513427588352404443fd685R598-R599
  
  However, I would prefer to keep it as a separate PR anyway so that the objective of this PR is clear
